patthana21.48:2.1: na āsavasampayuttaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ. na āsavavippayuttaṃ
patthana21.48:4.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā ekaṃ, (gaṇitakena tīṇi,) na āsavasampayutta na anidassana sappaṭighamūle tīṇi meva, na āsavasampayuttaṃ na anidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto anidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekaṃ, na āsavañceva na anāsavañca na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ
